rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design replaces a 54-file / 54,102-line sprawl with four functions of one interface each (`topology.read`, `current.book`, `gs.apply`, `solve.fixed_point`) that each hide hundreds of lines behind a pure, traced call; the interface is smaller than what it hides, which is the definition of depth.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §6's retirement enumerates a partial consumer set, but the three modules it deletes are imported across the package by files no ruling names, so the stated census ("covers the whole `nova` package, not `nova/equilibrium` alone") is contradicted by the tree it must run against; the benchmark corpus that consumes all three is not addressed at all.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0. Every section that adds a definition names what it retires in its own text (§2 retires the null/region authorities, §3 the clip entry, §4 the map, §5 the NK/Picard routes), and §6 prunes the request surface (`SolveRoute` 6→1, `SupportClipMode` deleted, eight policy fields removed) while stating the before/after field counts as the accounting the reduction rests on.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the existing mechanism for every subsystem it adds, and each citation resolves to a real symbol: `contour_tree.build_contour_tree` (`nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:384`) over `contour_tree_mesh.build_contour_mesh` (`contour_tree_mesh.py:193`), `polygon_moments.polygon_monomial_moments`/`polygon_density_moments` (`polygon_moments.py:141,187`), `ConstraintPair`/`ConstraintRecord` (`constraint.py:237,1843`), `nova/biot/null.py` (`Null1D`/`Null2D`/`inside_or_near_source_cell`, lines 32/45/232) and `nova/biot/fieldnull.py`, the `forward_operator.py` operand-layout helpers, `clip_quadrature.py`'s exact-clip helpers, and the `fixed_point.py` GMRES kernel plus `_backtracking_scores`/`_select_backtracking_candidate`. The sixteen composed-review rulings in the plan body each pin a file and a symbol, and the seven cite-or-justify candidates are all present in the tree.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — every new module names the mechanism it *replaces* rather than wrapping: §2 replaces `Topology.read`/`read_with_connectivity` (`topology.py:1396,1376`), §3 replaces `clipped_support_current_moments` and the `forward_operator.py` support partition, §4 replaces the map `ForwardFluxOperator` performs (`forward_operator.py:2323`), §5 replaces `newton_krylov`/`picard`/`operator_request_body` (`fixed_point.py:5003,2874,972`). `forward.py` shrinks to a request/receipt adapter rather than growing a parallel layer.
